title: Single-limit comparison for a supported strict class presentation
statement: For l prime, Y a scheme with the surface localization conventions, an ordinary strict reduction D, a chosen derived endpoint and arrow presentation p for D.E(diagonalIntegralSource),H, an ordinary completed supported-source cone s, and a normalized derived-limit model L, supportedSourceComparison is exactly diagonalSingleLimitComparison(F,L,diagonalCompletedSource,D.E(diagonalIntegralSource),p.K,s,p.source). Its explicit source is U(diagonalCompletedDomain). This names the existing comparison without modifying any map.
